steps.ties: A tie is a curved line joining two notes on the same key: play the first and keep holding through the second, without playing it again. It lets a note last across a bar line: the {f} here lasts two beats, one in each bar.
steps.tied: Three ties: hold each tied note through the bar line. The tenuto line on them is a reminder to hold.
steps.tiedInTime: Now in time: count through the tied notes.
